entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: final 16:9 landscape battle background for a high-end Korean 2D fantasy RPG, 2048x1152 requested. Elegant painterly semi-real fantasy game art, crisp intentional shapes and readable materials, atmospheric depth. No living beings, no monsters, no people, no lettering, no logos, no frames, no UI, no bright bloom obscuring the arena. Must clearly be a coastal battlefield, no forests, furnaces, temples or lava.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: a single transparent 2x2 monster sprite atlas for a high-end Korean fantasy RPG, square 2048x2048 requested. EXACTLY four isolated full-body monsters, one centered in each equal quadrant with generous transparent padding and no touching/crossing cells. TOP LEFT: a squat dark-teal armored harpoon crab, sharp pincer shaped like a natural harpoon, six articulated legs. TOP RIGHT: an adult fish-headed marauder with silver fin blades, an athletic natural-proportion humanoid body and a single straight harpoon held rigidly. BOTTOM LEFT: a drowned pirate in torn navy coat with barnacle encrusted shoulder and a cutlass, menacing but no graphic gore. BOTTOM RIGHT: the boss, an enormous hermit crab bearing an entire wrecked black-sailed galleon as its shell, asymmetrical huge claws and two clearly visible brass cannons in the wreck. Strong nautical identity, verdigris, slate blue, dark timber and brass. Painterly semi-real 2D game creature art, polished readable material, crisp silhouette. Each facing three-quarter left, anatomically coherent, battle-ready neutral pose; entire head, limbs, weapon and tail visible. Characters alone with true transparent background and no ground, scenery, cast shadow, plaques, borders, labels, numbers, text or UI. No chibi humans. All gun/harpoon shafts and metal rails are straight rigid objects; no bent segments. No detached stray pieces. Monster designs share the same rendering quality but have genuinely distinct body silhouettes. Restrained glow only inside body.
